scripts._comment_test: The glob is QUOTED so node expands it, not the shell: an unquoted `tests/*.test.ts` that matches nothing is passed through literally and the run dies with ENOENT, which is what a fresh scaffold with no tests yet would hit. Node's own expansion yields zero files and exits 0. (`--test tests/` does not work under tsx — its resolver tries to import the directory.)
scripts._comment_migrate: The base ships the migration runner and its own schema fragments; this applies them plus whatever `AgentModule.migrations` declares. It needs only DATABASE_URL — the base's boot config slice validates db+log and nothing else — so it runs before the app has a full env. `createAgent` also migrates on start(); this script is for CI and for a deploy step that migrates out of band.
scripts._comment_gates: The gate scripts ship inside @swampratnz/agent-base. `--root .` is required: without it they resolve their repo root inside node_modules.
